title: minuartia tenuifolia var. hybrida
intro: Minuartia tenuifolia var. hybrida, commonly known as Alpine Penny-cress, is a flowering plant species within the family Caryophyllaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support immune function and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, which may be beneficial in alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis. The plant's therapeutic actions include its use as an expectorant and anti-inflammatory agent, suggesting its potential to relieve congestion and reduce inflammation. Bioactive constituents present in Alpine Penny-cress include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are thought to contribute to its medicinal properties.
